chapterInfo.content:
8
Asetena mu ahwɛyie
1Mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa monhwɛ nyɛ, na moanya nkwa, na moadɔre, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo nananom no adi so. 2#Deut 13.3; Ate 2.22 Na kae kwan a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn maa wonantee so mfirinhyia aduanan yi ɛserɛ soɔ no nyinaa, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo ase asɔ wo ahwɛ, na wahunu deɛ ɛwɔ w’akoma mu, sɛ wobɛdi ne mmara nsɛm so anaasɛ worenni so. 3#Eks 16.13-15; Mat 4.4 Na ɔbrɛɛ wo ase maa ɛkɔm dee wo, na ɔde mana a wonnim na wo nananom nso nnim maa wo diiɛ, na wama woahunu sɛ, ɛnyɛ aduane nko so na onipa nam bɛtena aseɛ, na adeɛ biara a ɛfiri AWURADE anomu so na onipa nam tena aseɛ. 4#Deut 29.5 Wo ntoma ansu wo ho, na wo nan anhonhon mfirinhyia aduanan yi mu. 5#Deut 1.31 Na hunu no w’akoma mu sɛ, sɛdeɛ onipa tea ne ba no, saa ara na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn tea woɔ. 6Enti di AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, sɛ wobɛnante n’akwan soɔ na woasuro no. 7Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo rekɔ asase pa so, asase a ɛso wɔ nsubɔntene, nsuo aniwa ne atareɛ a ɛfifiri mmonhwa ne mmepɔ mu sene, 8asase a ayuo ne atokoɔ ne bobe ne borɔdɔma ne atoaa wɔ soɔ, asase a ɛso wɔ ngodua ne ɛwoɔ, 9asase a worenni so aduane na, na biribiara renhia wo wɔ soɔ, asase a n’aboɔ yɛ dadeɛ, na wɔbɛtu kɔbere afiri ne mmepɔ mu. 10Na sɛ wodidi mee a, hyira AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, asase pa a ɔde ama woɔ no nti.
11Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛ worenni ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ; 12na sɛ wodidi mee na wosisi adan pa tena mu, 13na w’anantwie ne wo nnwan dɔre, na wo dwetɛ ne wo sika dɔɔso ma wo, na adeɛ a wowɔ nyinaa dɔɔso a, 14hwɛ yie na w’akoma amma ne ho so, na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoa fie no; 15#Num 21.6; Eks 17.6 ɔno na ɔdii w’anim de wo faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ ne anyanyankyerɛ wɔ, ne nkyɛkyerɛ a nsuo nni hɔ so; ɔyii nsuo firii ɔbohemmaa botan mu maa wo; 16ɔde mana a wo nananom nnim maa wodii wɔ ɛserɛ so, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo aseɛ na wasɔ wo ahwɛ, na awieeɛ no, wayɛ wo yie, 17na woanka no w’akoma mu sɛ: M’ahoɔden ne me nsa den na ama manya ahonyadeɛ yi, 18#Deut 4.31 na mmom kae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔma wo ahoɔden a wode nya wo ho, na wama n’apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no atim sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi. 19Na sɛ wo werɛ firi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wokɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi som wɔn na wosɔre wɔn a, medi wo adanseɛ nnɛ, sɛ sɛeɛ na mobɛsɛeɛ. 20Sɛ amanaman a AWURADE sɛe wɔn firi mo anim no, saa ara na mobɛsɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nne.

Mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa monhwɛ nyɛ, na moanya nkwa, na moadɔre, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo nananom no adi so. Na kae kwan a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn maa wonantee so mfirinhyia aduanan yi ɛserɛ soɔ no nyinaa, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo ase asɔ wo ahwɛ, na wahunu deɛ ɛwɔ w’akoma mu, sɛ wobɛdi ne mmara nsɛm so anaasɛ worenni so. Na ɔbrɛɛ wo ase maa ɛkɔm dee wo, na ɔde mana a wonnim na wo nananom nso nnim maa wo diiɛ, na wama woahunu sɛ, ɛnyɛ aduane nko so na onipa nam bɛtena aseɛ, na adeɛ biara a ɛfiri AWURADE anomu so na onipa nam tena aseɛ. Wo ntoma ansu wo ho, na wo nan anhonhon mfirinhyia aduanan yi mu. Na hunu no w’akoma mu sɛ, sɛdeɛ onipa tea ne ba no, saa ara na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn tea woɔ. Enti di AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, sɛ wobɛnante n’akwan soɔ na woasuro no. Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo rekɔ asase pa so, asase a ɛso wɔ nsubɔntene, nsuo aniwa ne atareɛ a ɛfifiri mmonhwa ne mmepɔ mu sene, asase a ayuo ne atokoɔ ne bobe ne borɔdɔma ne atoaa wɔ soɔ, asase a ɛso wɔ ngodua ne ɛwoɔ, asase a worenni so aduane na, na biribiara renhia wo wɔ soɔ, asase a n’aboɔ yɛ dadeɛ, na wɔbɛtu kɔbere afiri ne mmepɔ mu. Na sɛ wodidi mee a, hyira AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, asase pa a ɔde ama woɔ no nti.
Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛ worenni ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ; na sɛ wodidi mee na wosisi adan pa tena mu, na w’anantwie ne wo nnwan dɔre, na wo dwetɛ ne wo sika dɔɔso ma wo, na adeɛ a wowɔ nyinaa dɔɔso a, hwɛ yie na w’akoma amma ne ho so, na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoa fie no; ɔno na ɔdii w’anim de wo faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ ne anyanyankyerɛ wɔ, ne nkyɛkyerɛ a nsuo nni hɔ so; ɔyii nsuo firii ɔbohemmaa botan mu maa wo; ɔde mana a wo nananom nnim maa wodii wɔ ɛserɛ so, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo aseɛ na wasɔ wo ahwɛ, na awieeɛ no, wayɛ wo yie, na woanka no w’akoma mu sɛ: M’ahoɔden ne me nsa den na ama manya ahonyadeɛ yi, na mmom kae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔma wo ahoɔden a wode nya wo ho, na wama n’apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no atim sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi. Na sɛ wo werɛ firi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wokɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi som wɔn na wosɔre wɔn a, medi wo adanseɛ nnɛ, sɛ sɛeɛ na mobɛsɛeɛ. Sɛ amanaman a AWURADE sɛe wɔn firi mo anim no, saa ara na mobɛsɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nne.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
